title: Feed_On_Kill
description: Kills mobs to get effect of saturation.
body:
This is a datapack of minecraft 1.21.7.Transform your combat experience with this meticulously designed datapack that provides hunger restoration on every kill. Each time you eliminate any entity - from zombies and creepers to peaceful animals and other players - you receive immediate sustenance recovery. This creates a dynamic risk-reward system where aggressive gameplay becomes a viable survival strategy.

The system uses Minecraft's native scoreboard objectives to monitor kill counts, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. You'll see heart particles emerge with each successful kill accompanied by classic Minecraft audio cues. Ideal for players who want more engaging combat loops without modifying core game mechanics.

Installation is effortless: simply place the datapack in your world's datapacks folder and reload. The system automatically initializes with appropriate scoreboards and begins tracking immediately. Perfect for survival enthusiasts, server administrators, and content creators looking to enhance their Minecraft experience.
